verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm a distinct sandbox environment exists alongside the live/production environment, using the same OAuth token-based authentication [entrust-onfido-docs-14]. However, there is no detail on how sandbox data isolation works, how to provision test applicants/documents, or any explicit guidance for AI-native/agentic testing workflows. Missing for 10: documentation on sandbox-specific test data/mock verification responses, guidance on switching environments in SDKs, and independent/hands-on confirmation that sandbox testing avoids touching production data.
